This deployment exposes media reads only; uploading, source retention/removal and metadata changes require their separately enabled workflow. Help: {action:"help"}; one action: {action:"help",topic:"<action>"}.

descriptions.reddit_native_action: Reddit Ads gateway for accounts, campaigns, lead generation, posts, catalogs, billing, and reporting. AMCP note: Nothing is written from this tool: a write action is previewed, or with dry_run:false refused with amcp_write inspect as its next_call.
descriptions.criteo_native_action: Criteo Retail Media gateway for accounts, campaigns, line items, creatives, audiences, catalogs, budgets, billing, and reporting. AMCP note: Nothing is written from this tool: a write action is previewed, or with dry_run:false refused with amcp_write inspect as its next_call.
descriptions.ga4_native_action: Google Analytics 4 gateway for properties, metadata, reports, asynchronous report tasks and audience exports. Providers are connected on the AMCP website (Connections). Listed for catalog compatibility but not run by AMCP (refused with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; details.alternatives names what to use): ga4_connection_ops start, exchange, refresh. AMCP note: Nothing is written from this tool: a write action is previewed, or with dry_run:false refused with amcp_write inspect as its next_call.
descriptions.gtm_native_action: Google Tag Manager gateway: gtm_ops runs one Tag Manager API operation on accounts, containers, workspaces, versions, tags, triggers and variables; gtm_audit_ops audits a workspace’s configuration and consent settings; gtm_action_job_status reads the verification job of a reviewed Tag Manager write. AMCP note: Nothing is written from this tool: a write action is previewed, or with dry_run:false refused with amcp_write inspect as its next_call.
descriptions.google_business_native_action: Google Business Profile gateway for accounts, locations, catalogs, verification, engagement, performance, notifications and lodging. Providers are connected on the AMCP website (Connections). Listed for catalog compatibility but not run by AMCP (refused with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; details.alternatives names what to use): gmb_connection_ops start, exchange, refresh and gmb_engagement_ops LEGACY_V4_REQUEST. AMCP note: Nothing is written from this tool: a write action is previewed, or with dry_run:false refused with amcp_write inspect as its next_call.
descriptions.google_search_console_native_action: Google Search Console gateway for sites, sitemaps, URL inspection and search analytics. Providers are connected on the AMCP website (Connections). Listed for catalog compatibility but not run by AMCP (refused with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; details.alternatives names what to use): gsc_connection_ops start, exchange, refresh. AMCP note: Nothing is written from this tool: a write action is previewed, or with dry_run:false refused with amcp_write inspect as its next_call.
descriptions.adjust_native_action: Adjust gateway: adjust_reporting (apps, events, filters, reports and pivots) and adjust_list_assets (the Adjust bindings configured in AMCP) run. Listed for catalog compatibility but not run by AMCP (refused with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; details.alternatives names what to use): adjust_ad_spend, adjust_app_automation, adjust_campaign_api and adjust_deeplinks.
descriptions.commerce_native_action: Commerce gateway: woocommerce_list_stores lists the WooCommerce stores configured in AMCP, without a store request; store products are read through amcp_workspace catalog_sources and catalog_source. Shopify and Salla have no AMCP connection, and Shopify, Salla and WooCommerce expansion is parked. Listed for catalog compatibility but not run by AMCP (refused with CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; details.alternatives names what to use): woocommerce_store_ops.
descriptions.amcp_tool_help: Discover compact AMCP MCP gateways and inspect the exact nested schema for an operation. This is read-only metadata and does not call an advertising platform.
descriptions.amcp_ad_previews: Use this to see existing ads as the platform shows them, with links that expire. For media files use amcp_media. Safety: reads only; nothing is saved. Core: platform, account_id, ad_ids or statuses, campaign_ids and adset_ids, limit (default 5, at most 10), cursor; ad_format selects a Meta placement. Help: {action:"help"}.
descriptions.amcp_write: Use this to check whether a single advertising or measurement change has a reviewed write contract, and to create a provider report or export job. inspect checks local write-contract support for the exact native arguments, without credentials or network calls, and saves nothing. This deployment is read-only for advertising changes; its owner allows provider report and export jobs (X, TikTok and Meta report jobs, Criteo reports, DV360 SDF exports, TikTok change logs and GA4 report tasks). For a job, prepare reads state and freezes a five-minute review, execute submits it once after confirmed=true and never resubmits it, and status reads a retained review back. A job needs the account’s report-job grant (AMCP Connections). This is an AMCP extension, not a captured AMCP tool.
descriptions.amcp_media: Use this to inspect account-scoped retained media metadata, original-source availability, verified AMCP plan usage and compatible retained ad performance. Actions: list, library, asset, asset_performance and asset_usage (bounded current Meta v26 image/video references, complete Google v25 image asset links with reference_view ad_images, performance_max or performance_max_brand, and the Snapchat snapchat_top_snap view). These reads create no snapshot, plan, ownership or write grant and need no upload write grant. This deployment exposes media reads only; uploading, source retention/removal and metadata changes require their separately enabled workflow. Help: {action:"help"}; one action: {action:"help",topic:"<action>"}.
